(let ((dummy 0)) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range 1 (- (rows g) 1))) (c (in-range 1 (- (cols g) 1)))) (if (and (= (at g r c) 3) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 3) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 3) (= (at g r (- c 1)) 3) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 3)) (paint-cells out (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) c) (list (+ r 1) c) (list r (- c 1)) (list r (+ c 1))) 7) out))))

(rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range 1 (- (rows g) 1))) (c (in-range 1 (- (cols g) 1)))) (if (and (= (at g r c) 3) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 3) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 3) (= (at g r (- c 1)) 3) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 3)) (paint-cells out (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) c) (list (+ r 1) c) (list r (- c 1)) (list r (+ c 1))) 7) out))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define base
      (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range 1 (- (rows g) 1))) (c (in-range 1 (- (cols g) 1))))
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 3) (= (at g (- r 1) c) 3) (= (at g (+ r 1) c) 3)
                 (= (at g r (- c 1)) 3) (= (at g r (+ c 1)) 3))
            (paint-cells out (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) c) (list (+ r 1) c)
                                   (list r (- c 1)) (list r (+ c 1))) 7)
            out)))
    (define detected-centers
      (filter
        (lambda (p)
          (let ([r (first p)] [c (second p)])
            (and (> r 0) (< r (- (rows base) 1)) (> c 0) (< c (- (cols base) 1))
                 (= (at base (- r 1) c) 7) (= (at base (+ r 1) c) 7)
                 (= (at base r (- c 1)) 7) (= (at base r (+ c 1)) 7))))
        (find-color base 7)))
    (define centers detected-centers)
    (define candidates
      (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 3) (>= (obj-size o) 3))) (objects base 0)))
    (define (distance o)
      (apply min
        (for*/list ([p (in-list (obj-cells o))] [q (in-list centers)])
          (+ (abs (- (first p) (first q))) (abs (- (second p) (second q)))))))
    (define selected (first (sort candidates (lambda (a b) (< (distance a) (distance b))))))
    (paint-cells base (obj-cells selected) 8)))
